description: Reads a NONMEM CSV file, recognises the reserved columns (ID, TIME, DV, AMT, EVID, MDV, CMT...), converts '.' to missing values, computes the relative time, the time after dose (TAD) and the dose-normalised DV, and flags BLQ records.
code:
dat <- nm_read_csv(file.path(ex, "example_data.csv"))
head(dat$data)     # standardised data
dat$mapping        # reserved labels -> original column names

description: Number of subjects, records and observations, proportion of BLQ, time range, distinct doses and observed compartments.
code: nm_summary(dat$data)

description: Observed concentrations against TIME or TAD, with the median and an interval band, on linear and/or log scale, optionally stratified by a covariate.
code:
nm_plot_dv(dat$data, scales = "both")
nm_plot_dv(dat$data, time_var = "TAD", scales = "log")
nm_plot_dv(dat$data, y = "DV_norm", strat = "GENO")   # dose-normalised

description: Reads the dataset, summarises it and draws the raw and dose-normalised profiles in one call, with configurable BLQ handling and optional JPEG/CSV export.
code:
pv <- nm_data_previsual(file.path(ex, "example_data.csv"),
                        scales = "both", dose_norm = TRUE)
pv$summary
pv$plot_dv
pv$plot_norm

description: Adds a RATE column (e.g. -2 for an estimated zero-order duration) on all doses or only on some routes, keeping the exact format of the file.
code:
# RATE = -2 on every dose -> example_data_rate.csv next to the source file
nm_add_rate(file.path(ex, "example_data.csv"), dose_value = -2)

description: Writes a data.frame as CSV with the NONMEM convention for missing values ('.').
code: nm_export_data(dat$data, file.path(ex, "data_nm.csv"))

description: Checks that a dataset can be read by NONMEM: missing ID or TIME, non-increasing times, inconsistent EVID/MDV/AMT, duplicates, non-numeric columns, outliers.

task: Suggest a structural model and initial values
description: Analyses the data before any NONMEM run and ranks candidate models (compartments, input, elimination, residual error), each with initial values for THETA, IIV and SIGMA and alerts on what no candidate describes.
code:
s <- nm_suggest_model(file.path(ex, "example_data.csv"))
s                       # ranked candidates, initial values, alerts
plot(s, "profiles")
plot(s, "support")

description: Expected RSE of the parameters and eta-shrinkage of a candidate for the sampling design of the dataset or for another design, from the population Fisher information matrix.
code:
nm_suggest_design(s, candidate = 1)
# sparse design: 3 samples, 100 subjects
nm_suggest_design(s, times = c(1, 4, 12), n_subjects = 100)

description: Writes the control streams of the chosen candidates, runs them with nm_run(), reads their OFV and ranks them by BIC.
code:
r <- nm_suggest_run(s, analysis_dir = ex, nmfe_path = nmfe,
                    candidates = 1:3, n_cores = 3)
r                       # OFV, BIC, ranks, Spearman correlation

description: Compares the individual estimates (CL, central volume, absorption) between covariate groups with the Wasserstein distance, before any modelling.
code: nm_suggest_covariates(s, covariates = c("WT", "GENO"))

description: Writes a complete control stream for a compartmental PK model (1 to 3 compartments, IV or extravascular, first-order, zero-order or transit absorption, linear or Michaelis-Menten elimination), possibly from a candidate of nm_suggest_model().
code:
# from candidate 1 of a suggestion
nm_write_ctl(file.path(ex, "run3.ctl"), from = s, candidate = 1)
# or from the dataset columns
nm_write_ctl(input = file.path(ex, "example_data.csv"), error = "combined")

description: Checks a control stream without NM-TRAN: THETA, ETA and EPS used without declaration, items missing from $INPUT, M3 requirements; optional line differences from a reference.
code:
nm_ctl_check(file.path(ex, "run2.ctl"))
ctl <- nm_write_ctl(input = file.path(ex, "example_data.csv"))
nm_ctl_check(nm_ctl_mu(ctl), reference = ctl)

description: Rewrites log-normal parameters as MU_m = LOG(THETA(n)) and P = EXP(MU_m + ETA(m)), as required by EM and Bayesian methods (SAEM, IMP, BAYES).
code:
ctl <- nm_write_ctl(input = file.path(ex, "example_data.csv"), error = "combined")
nm_ctl_mu(ctl)
nm_ctl_mu(ctl, parameters = c("CL", "V"), mode = "linear")

description: Adds IOV to chosen parameters with $ABBR REPLACE and $OMEGA BLOCK SAME; the occasion item must be in $INPUT.
code:
cols <- c("ID", "TIME", "AMT", "DV", "EVID", "MDV", "CMT", "OCC", "BQL")
ctl  <- nm_write_ctl(input = cols, error = "combined")
nm_ctl_iov(ctl, parameters = c("CL", "V"), n_occ = 3, occ = "OCC")

description: Applies the M3 method (Beal 2001): BLQ observations contribute P(DV < LLOQ); the LLOQ is a constant, a dataset column or depends on the analytical method.
code:
cols <- c("ID", "TIME", "AMT", "DV", "EVID", "MDV", "CMT", "OCC", "BQL")
ctl  <- nm_write_ctl(input = cols, error = "combined")
nm_ctl_m3(ctl, bql = "BQL", lloq = 0.02)

task: Convert a Wings label control stream
description: Converts a Wings for NONMEM 'extended' control stream, where the model uses the parameter labels, into a standard one (THETA(n), ETA(n), ERR(n)).
code:
# a Wings control stream of your own (not in the example project)
nm_convert_ctl("C:/myproject/run_wings.ctl")   # -> run_wings_converted.ctl

description: Runs control streams with nmfe, without Wings or PsN, each in its own run directory; finished runs are skipped. n_cores runs several models at the same time.
code:
log <- nm_run(nmfe_path    = nmfe,
              ctl_files    = c("run1.ctl", "run2.ctl"),
              analysis_dir = ex,
              n_cores      = 2)
log[, c("run", "action", "ofv", "min_ok", "cov_status")]

description: Logical and physical cores of the computer and the number of simultaneous runs used by n_cores = "auto".
code: nm_cores()

task: Summarise all runs of a project
description: Reads every run of an analysis folder: OFV, dOFV, AIC/BIC, minimisation and covariance status, warnings, and all parameters named from the model code (CL, V, KA...).
code:
runs <- nm_extract_runs(ex)
runs                                  # one line per run
nm_filter_runs(runs, "successful")$runs

description: One row per parameter and one column per run, aligned by name or by NONMEM index; values, RSE, SE or shrinkage.
code:
nm_compare_runs(runs, format = TRUE)         # value (RSE%)
nm_compare_runs(runs, what = "shrinkage")

description: Parameter table of a run (estimates, SE, RSE, 95% CI, SD of ETAs and EPS, ETA correlations) exported to a Word document in the run directory.
code:
res <- nm_extract_run_table(run_path = file.path(ex, "run2.reg"))
res$params          # the table in R
res$output_file     # the Word file

task: Identify the role of THETAs and ETAs
description: Reads $PK or $PRED and links each THETA and ETA to the PK parameter it acts on, with its role (typical value, covariate effect, IIV, residual error).
code:
x <- nm_identify_parameters(file.path(ex, "run2.ctl"))
x$parameter_table
nm_identify_directory(ex)          # every control stream of a folder

description: Summary table of all runs of a project exported to Word (today nm_extract_runs() gives it in R only).
Tree of the runs with, for each, its parent run, OFV, dOFV and convergence status.
Standard diagnostic plots from a NONMEM table: observations vs population and individual predictions, CWRES, NPDE and IWRES vs time and predictions.
code:
gof <- nm_gof(file.path(ex, "run2.reg"))
plot(gof)
nm_gof(file.path(ex, "run2.reg"), by = "GENO")

task: Compare two models (LRT, Vuong, Clarke, bootstrap, influence)
description: Paired comparison of two runs: CWRES and NPDE, individual OFVs, Vuong and Clarke tests for non-nested models, LRT if nested, subject bootstrap of dOFV, influence, paired parameters and ETAs; summary() gives a decision grid.
code:
cmp <- nm_compare(file.path(ex, "run1.reg"), file.path(ex, "run2.reg"),
                  labels = c("Base", "Final"),
                  covariates = c("WT", "GENO"))
summary(cmp)            # decision grid
cmp$tests$table

description: Where the second model improves or degrades the fit (gain map with bootstrap band), diagnostics of both runs overlaid, caterpillar of individual dOFV, parameters and ETAs.
code:
plot(cmp, which = "gain_map", n_band = 200)
plot(cmp, which = c("overlay_gof", "iofv_caterpillar", "eta_scatter"))

task: Optimise a base model without iterative runs
description: Ranks the possible changes of a base model (residual error, random effects, covariates) by their expected dOFV, from its outputs (level 1) and one NONMEM evaluation run (level 2, linearised model).
code:
# level 1 only, no NONMEM run
nm_optimize_base(file.path(ex, "run1.reg"), covariates = c("WT", "GENO"), level = 1)
# level 2: one evaluation run, then the linearised model
p <- nm_derivatives_ctl(file.path(ex, "run1.reg"))   # -> run1_deriv.ctl
nm_run(nmfe, basename(p), dirname(p))
o <- nm_optimize_base(file.path(ex, "run1.reg"), covariates = c("WT", "GENO"))
o
plot(o)

description: Compares the distribution of an ETA between covariate groups with the Wasserstein distance and a permutation test, with the Wasserstein R2 between runs (Simon et al., Front Pharmacol 2026).
code:
w <- nm_wasserstein(c(BASE  = file.path(ex, "run1.reg"),
                      FINAL = file.path(ex, "run2.reg")),
                    covariates = c("WT", "GENO"), eta = "CL")
w
plot(w)
plot(w, type = "r2w")

description: Writes and runs the _orig and _sim control streams of a VPC from an estimated run, then draws observed percentiles against the confidence intervals of simulated percentiles.
code:
nm_vpc_ctl("run2", ex, nmfe_path = nmfe, n_sim = 500, n_cores = 2)
cols <- c("NSIM", "ID", "TIME", "AMT", "MDV", "DV", "PRED", "IPRED")
nm_vpc("run2", ex, col_names = cols)

description: Prediction-corrected VPC (Bergstrand 2011) from the same simulation runs as the VPC.
code:
cols <- c("NSIM", "ID", "TIME", "AMT", "MDV", "DV", "PRED", "IPRED")
nm_vpc("run2", ex, col_names = cols, type = 2, bin_method = 3)  # nominal times

description: Non-parametric bootstrap by subject: reproducible and optionally stratified resampling, resume after interruption, percentile confidence intervals and success rate.
code:
boot <- nm_bootstrap(file.path(ex, "run2.reg", "run2.ctl"),
                     nmfe_path = nmfe, n = 500, seed = 1,
                     strata = "GENO", n_cores = "auto")
boot
plot(boot)

description: Leave-one-subject-out runs ranked by |dOFV|, with relative and standardised THETA shifts. A descriptive influence diagnostic, not an outlier test.
code:
jk <- nm_jackknife(file.path(ex, "run2.reg", "run2.ctl"),
                   nmfe_path = nmfe, n_cores = "auto")
jk
plot(jk, "bar")
plot(jk, "scatter")

description: Fixes a THETA at each value of a grid, re-runs the model and reads the OFV; the confidence interval is where dOFV crosses 3.84.
code:
prof <- nm_profile(nmfe, file.path(ex, "run2.reg", "run2.ctl"),
                   param = "CL", from = 4.6, to = 5.7, by = 0.1,
                   n_cores = "auto")
prof
plot(prof, type = "dofv")

description: Saves a ggplot to JPEG, PNG, PDF or TIFF according to the file extension, creating the folder if needed.
code:
g <- nm_plot_dv(dat$data)
nm_export_plot(g, file.path(ex, "figures", "dv_time.png"), width = 8, height = 5)

description: Writes all goodness-of-fit plots of a run to a Word document next to its table.
code: nm_gof(file.path(ex, "run2.reg"), save_docx = TRUE)
